relationships.subject: mGluR4
relationships.evidence_quote: mGluR4 reduces glutamate release, which may mitigate excitotoxic damage in this neurodegenerative condition.

relationships.subject: mGluR4 positive allosteric modulators
relationships.evidence_quote: PAMs enhance the receptor’s response to endogenous glutamate, effectively increasing its activity without directly activating the receptor itself.

key_findings: Review of mGluR4 PAM patents 2017-present (Roche, Vanderbilt, Prexton/Domain).
Foliglurax failed to improve off time or dyskinesia in Phase II.
